title: Title Bar
purpose: Window control bar with menus (File, Edit, View) and window controls (minimize, maximize, close)
states: fullscreen - menu items reflect fullscreen state
acceptance: shall display File menu with New Window, Open, Save operations
shall display Edit menu with undo, cut, copy, paste operations
shall display View menu with terminal, sidebar, fullscreen toggles
shall display window controls (minimize, maximize, close) on right
shall gray out menu items that are not available for current state
shall show window title with active app or cluster name
shall support keyboard accelerators for menu items
